## Setup

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
  library(patchwork)
  library(forcats)
  library(ggrepel)
})

source("helper_functions.R")
```

```{r paths}
out_dir   <- file.path("output", "03_RCTD_SpotDeconvolution") 
liana_dir <- file.path("output", "03b_runLiana_scRNAseq") 
```

## Load the spatial pipeline results from 03a

```{r load-spatial-pipelines}
lr_coloc_pipelines <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "lr_coloc_pipelines.rds"))

astro_vasc     <- lr_coloc_pipelines$astro_vasc
vasc_microglia <- lr_coloc_pipelines$vasc_microglia
opc_cr         <- lr_coloc_pipelines$opc_cr
neuro_gc       <- lr_coloc_pipelines$neuro_gc
```

# Compare each pair's spatial results to its LIANA+ CCC scRNA-seq results

`compare_spatial_to_liana()` and `plot_cross_modality_trajectory()` (helper_functions.R) join a spatial pipeline result to its matching age-split LIANA+ CSV and check 3-way sign agreement (spatial slope, spatial detection enrichment, scRNA evidence) on the young-to-old shift.

## Astrocyte - Vascular

```{r liana-compare-astro-vasc, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
astro_vasc_liana <- compare_spatial_to_liana(astro_vasc, file.path(liana_dir, "liana_astro_vasc_by_age.csv"))

astro_vasc_liana$pairs_dropped_incomplete   # pairs missing an age in one of the joined tables
astro_vasc_liana$agreement_check

plot_cross_modality_trajectory(astro_vasc_liana,
                                "Astrocyte-Vascular: spatial and scRNA evidence moving together with age")

astro_vasc_liana$pair_detail_wide
```

## Vascular - Microglia

```{r liana-compare-vasc-microglia, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
vasc_microglia_liana <- compare_spatial_to_liana(vasc_microglia, file.path(liana_dir, "liana_vasc_microglia_by_age.csv"))

vasc_microglia_liana$pairs_dropped_incomplete
vasc_microglia_liana$agreement_check

plot_cross_modality_trajectory(vasc_microglia_liana,
                                "Vascular-Microglia: spatial and scRNA evidence moving together with age")

vasc_microglia_liana$pair_detail_wide
```

## Neurogenic_lineage - GC

```{r liana-compare-neuro-gc, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
neuro_gc_liana <- compare_spatial_to_liana(neuro_gc, file.path(liana_dir, "liana_neuro_gc_by_age.csv"))
```

# Export the curated (3-metric-agreement) significant LR pairs

The four `pair_detail_wide` tables above are already restricted to the pairs where all 3 metrics -- spatial slope, spatial detection enrichment, and scRNA `magnitude_rank` -- agree in sign on their young-to-old shift (`compare_spatial_to_liana()`'s `agreement_check` filter). This is the curated set shown in the `plot_cross_modality_trajectory()` plots above, as opposed to every raw candidate pair in the `liana_*_by_age.csv` files. Exporting it here.

```{r export-significant-lr-pairs, warning=FALSE}
significant_lr_pairs <- bind_rows(
  astro_vasc_liana$pair_detail_wide     %>% mutate(spatial_pair = "Astrocyte-Vascular"),
  vasc_microglia_liana$pair_detail_wide %>% mutate(spatial_pair = "Vascular-Microglia"),
  opc_cr_liana$pair_detail_wide         %>% mutate(spatial_pair = "OPC-Cajal-Retzius"),
  neuro_gc_liana$pair_detail_wide       %>% mutate(spatial_pair = "Neurogenic_lineage-GC")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(spatial_pair, pair, ligand_complex, receptor_complex,
                direction_young, direction_middle, direction_old, direction_consistent,
                slope_shift, enrichment_shift, scrna_shift,
                slope_pattern, enrichment_pattern)

write.csv(significant_lr_pairs, file.path(out_dir, "significant_lr_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_lr_pairs
```
